subject: Prompted demo: Redwood Inference — quick demo for Nimble Data
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Grant <alex.grant@nimbledata.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Quick demo? Saw Nimble hit our self-serve threshold

Hi Alex —

Congrats on the increased usage — I noticed your team at nimbledata.com just crossed our self-serve threshold for request volume. We run short, targeted demos for customers in this stage to show the cost/latency levers (batching, KV caching) and the Dedicated options that often make sense as you scale.

Would you be open to a 30-minute session this week? I can cover:
- Quick walkthrough of the Redwood Console dashboards you’ll see
- Cost/latency levers relevant to your workload
- Next steps (pilot, Dedicated sizing, security pack)

A couple of slots I have: Thu 11/05 10:00–10:30 PT, Thu 11/05 14:00–14:30 PT, Fri 11/06 09:00–09:30 PT. Or feel free to pick a time here: https://calendly.com/jordan-redwood/30min

Attaching a short overview of Redwood to give context ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-overview.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Alex Grant <alex.grant@nimbledata.com>

Cc: 
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick demo? Saw Nimble hit our self-serve threshold

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the reach out. We’re definitely interested in understanding how to control costs as we scale. Quick notes:
- Could we move the meeting to Fri 11/06 in the afternoon PT? Morning is tough for our lead infra engineer.
- Can we include our engineering manager, Priya (priya.nimble@nimbledata.com)? She’ll want to ask about SSO/KMS integrations and deployment options.

If you can include someone from post-sales/implementation that knows SSO and VPC options that would be ideal. Also curious if you have any pre-read on SSO/KMS compatibility.

Best,
Alex Grant
Head of Analytics Platform | Nimble Data
alex.grant@nimbledata.com

Perfect — thanks for the context, Alex. I’ve looped in Marissa (Solutions Engineer) who owns SSO/KMS and private deployment details. She can cover the integration checklist during the demo.

I have these Fri slots open (PT):
- Fri 11/06 13:00–13:30 PT
- Fri 11/06 15:00–15:30 PT

If either works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short agenda. Pre-reads: I attached a one-page SSO/KMS compatibility note and a draft agenda.

Agenda (proposed):

2) Integration & security checklist (10m) — Marissa
3) Next steps: pilot sizing & timeline (10m)

Thanks,
Jordan
